description: MEASURED by <your name> on <date>: <describe your ramp, ruler and marks>

persistence.process_entry: Each declaration is one static set of height readings. The evaluation record begins with this set; no earlier set of this ramp has been admitted, and no sequence of observations is declared.

inputs.name: obs.P1
inputs.source_identity: <your ruler, e.g. '300 mm steel rule'> read at mark P1
inputs.acquisition_method: ruler held vertically on the tabletop, read at the height of mark P1
inputs.relationship_to_problem: height of mark P1 above the tabletop, the observable at locus P1

inputs.name: obs.P2
inputs.source_identity: <your ruler, e.g. '300 mm steel rule'> read at mark P2
inputs.acquisition_method: ruler held vertically on the tabletop, read at the height of mark P2
inputs.relationship_to_problem: height of mark P2 above the tabletop, the observable at locus P2

inputs.name: obs.P3
inputs.source_identity: <your ruler, e.g. '300 mm steel rule'> read at mark P3
inputs.acquisition_method: ruler held vertically on the tabletop, read at the height of mark P3
inputs.relationship_to_problem: height of mark P3 above the tabletop, the observable at locus P3

inputs.name: obs.P4
inputs.source_identity: <your ruler, e.g. '300 mm steel rule'> read at mark P4
inputs.acquisition_method: ruler held vertically on the tabletop, read at the height of mark P4
inputs.relationship_to_problem: height of mark P4 above the tabletop, the observable at locus P4

inputs.name: rho_base
inputs.acquisition_method: declared by M for this example (kernel_reference.md §9: M-supplied, no kernel value)
inputs.relationship_to_problem: dimensionless ceiling of ρ used by operator_r
inputs.known_limitations: <no observational basis unless you have one>

inputs.name: chi_0
inputs.acquisition_method: declared by M for this example (kernel_reference.md §9: M-supplied, no kernel value)
inputs.relationship_to_problem: reference of the saturating map in ρ, in the dimension of χ (mm)
inputs.known_limitations: <no observational basis unless you have one>

regional_prerequisite.orientation_preserved: the height of each mark above the tabletop, in mm, as read on the ruler
regional_prerequisite.orientation_discarded: everything else about the marks and the ramp: position along the ramp, width of the pencil line, the marble's speed, reading uncertainty
regional_prerequisite.admission_rule_description: A height reading is admitted into evaluation only when it lies on the ruler's printed scale, 0 mm to 300 mm inclusive.

mappings.name: m.lesson1.identity
mappings.input_description: a height reading in mm, as written in the declaration
mappings.output_description: the same value in D, in mm
mappings.preserves: the height reading of each mark in mm
mappings.discards: everything about the mark except its height reading

edges.description: <what you observed: the marble rolling from P1 directly to P2>
<what you observed: the marble rolling from P2 directly to P3>
<what you observed: the marble rolling from P3 directly to P4>

operator_parameters._note: rho_base and chi_0 must be declared by M. 'declared' means you chose them without an observational basis; IRRS reports that as OPEN. Do not copy values from another domain.

lesson.detection_tolerance_basis: implementation-only numerical tolerance for finite-precision arithmetic (kernel_reference.md §11.5); not a property of the ramp

_instructions: TEMPLATE for your own measured set. Copy to my_set_<name>.json (that name is git-ignored), fill every empty string and null, and see 02_OBSERVABLE_SET.md and 04_EXPERIMENTAL_EXERCISES.md. Change observational_support from 'proposed' to 'observed' ONLY for a mark or passage you actually observed, and then add at least one evidence entry naming where you recorded it. Fields starting with '_' are ignored.
